# Button Up Media

> Button Up Media is a restaurant marketing agency based in Miami, Florida. It works only with hospitality businesses (restaurants, bars, cafes, coffee shops and restaurant groups) across Miami, South Florida and the United States, in English and Spanish. Founded in 2022 by Juan Hernandez and Christian Paula, who work directly with every client.

## Key facts

- Location: Miami, FL, USA. Serves Miami, Brickell, Wynwood, Coral Gables, Doral, Fort Lauderdale, Boca Raton, West Palm Beach and the rest of Florida, plus clients across the US.
- Focus: hospitality only. Success is measured in reservations, calls, online orders and foot traffic rather than follower counts.
- Languages: English and Spanish (bilingual team and bilingual website).
- Results: more than 200 million organic social media views across client accounts; Brewing Buddha 40M organic views; Fatty Crab 21M+ views and 110K followers; Shimuja Ramen 15.4M views; 50+ restaurants served.
- Pricing (published): restaurant website builds are $1,500 (Website Build) or $2,000 (Integrated Website Build), one-time. Most restaurants invest $1,500 to $5,000 per month for a coordinated multi-channel marketing program.
- Free consultation: every strategy call is hosted personally by co-founder Juan Hernandez.

## Services

- [Restaurant social media marketing and content creation](https://www.buttonupmedia.com/socialmediamarketing): on-site video and food photography, Reels and TikToks, posting strategy and community management. Spanish: https://www.buttonupmedia.com/es/marketing-redes-sociales
- [Restaurant website design](https://www.buttonupmedia.com/restaurant-website-design): custom-coded, mobile-first, bilingual sites built to take bookings and orders, with SEO basics and local pages. Spanish: https://www.buttonupmedia.com/es/diseno-web-restaurantes
- [Restaurant Google Ads and Meta Ads](https://www.buttonupmedia.com/restaurant-advertising): paid search and paid social for reservations, calls and private-event leads, with conversion tracking. Spanish: https://www.buttonupmedia.com/es/publicidad-restaurantes
- [Restaurant SEO and Google Business Profile optimization](https://www.buttonupmedia.com/restaurant-seo): Google Maps / map pack visibility, local keywords, technical fixes, listings, reviews and AI-answer readiness. Spanish: https://www.buttonupmedia.com/es/seo-restaurantes
- [Free Restaurant Social Media & Website Grader](https://www.buttonupmedia.com/social-media-website-grader): an AI report card on a restaurant's website, Google listing and social media, compared with nearby competitors. Spanish: https://www.buttonupmedia.com/es/analizador-redes-sociales-web
